Indian Railways fines caterer after fly found in passenger's meal

Indian Railways has imposed a fine of Rs 1 lakh on a food caterer after a passenger found a fly in their meal served on the Tejas Express. The incident occurred on the Ahmedabad-Mumbai Tejas Express. The fine was levied by IRCTC following a complaint about the food quality.
